cases.name: Margo Shamberger Prade MD
cases.about: Her obituary said, " She attended Akron Public Schools, graduated with honors as a valedictorian from Central Hower High School in 1975. Margo was an excellent student who never received a grade less than an "A." Her love of learning led her to enroll in Kent State University, where she was homecoming queen and graduated from an accelerated program which offered a Bachelor of Science degree in 1983. Simultaneously, she received her medical degree from Northeast Ohio College of Medicine. She loved children, and had a God-given dedication to help them live a happy and healthy life. This resulted in her specialization in Family Practice Medicine... Margo was a lover of sports who sponsored a baseball team, loved the Chicago Bulls, and loved to attend the Indians baseball games. Her children's accomplishments made Margo very proud and happy to involve herself with their school and extracurricular activities.
cases.narrative: On 11/26/1997, her body was discovered slumped behind the wheel of her car in her office parking lot. She was shot six times and bitten on the shoulder.
